See the transformation

From tired to transformed

Watch how we bring a roof back to life, the same standard of finish we deliver on every job across Chesterfield and Derbyshire.

Before → After
Complete Re-Roof

A tired roof brought back to life

Stripped from the rafters up and rebuilt properly: new breathable membrane, treated battens and fresh interlocking tiles, finished with clean ridge and leadwork throughout. What was a worn, dated roof is now smart, straight and watertight, ready to protect the home for decades to come.

Staveley
Before → After
Fibreglass Flat Roof

A flat roof sealed for good

This tired flat roof was stripped right back to fresh timber decking, then finished in seamless grey GRP fibreglass with clean black trims. No felt laps to lift and no joints to fail, just one solid, watertight surface built to shrug off the Derbyshire weather for decades.

Chesterfield
Before → After
Full Re-Roof

From mossy and worn to brand new

Decades of moss and blistered old tiles came off, and the whole roof was re-covered with fresh interlocking tiles over a breathable membrane and new battens. New valley leadwork, a re-bedded ridge and a smart skylight finish it off, leaving a clean, uniform roof ready for the next generation.

Meet the family

A family name you can trust on your roof

Lords Roofing & Sons is a genuine family-run firm, born and based right here in Chesterfield. For over twenty years we've been keeping Derbyshire's roofs watertight, and the same hands that started the business are still on the tools today.

We're a multi-trade roofing contractor handling everything from insurance repairs and property maintenance to complete re-roofs. Because we're family-run, our name is on every job, so we do it properly, treat your home with respect, and stand behind our work with a genuine guarantee.

Fast, friendly, local service guaranteed. That's not just a tagline, it's how we've earned hundreds of great reviews and so much repeat custom across the area.
